text:
marie: Quick sync — planning to flip feature flag `curation_v2` for 23:00 UTC tonight (small slice->100%). Who can own the flip, run the quick smoke, and be ready to rollback if anything odd shows up?

alex: I can take the flip and watch the dashboards. free at 22:45 to prep :+1:

nora: I can run smoke tests and prom checks right after the flip. will validate search rerank + embeddings latency.

sam: What’s the safe-default if we need to fallback quickly? do we flip to an explicit off, or to `curation_v1` routing?

marie: Good q. Safe-default is explicit off and tenant routing to `curation_v1`. Putting the exact commands below. Also flag rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m windows unless errors > 2% or latency > 200ms.

marie: ```bash
# enable canary (5%)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/flags/curation_v2/rollout 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" 
  -d '{"percent":5}'

# to disable immediately (safe-default)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/flags/curation_v2/disable 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"

# to pin routing back
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/tenants/route 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" 
  -d '{"from":"curation_v2","to":"curation_v1"}'
```

alex: Copy. I’ll do the rollout. Can someone own the rollback command if I ask to disable? I might need a second pair of eyes to hit prod.

nora: I’ll be on standby for rollback. Will keep a checklist open: hits on /search, queue depth, 95p latency, and prediction delta for top-10 queries.

sam: Added a quick smoke script here for reference, run locally or in the smoke job: `scripts/smoke/curation_v2_check.sh` — covers sample queries + embedding sanity.

marie: Thanks. Ops playbook note: if errors spike above 2% within first 5m or 95p latency increases by >100ms, abort and disable immediately. Alex — ping here when you start each stage so we have timestamps.

alex: Will do. plan: prep at 22:45, start 23:00 -> 5% at 23:00, 25% at 23:15, 100% at 23:30. I’ll post the rollout ts for each step.

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag rollout job created by alex for curation_v2 — job_id: jr_90321 — starts 2024-06-18T23:00:00Z

nora: I’ll post the smoke results into this thread after each step. if anything looks off i’ll call rollback and tag @alex here.

marie: Awesome. If everyone’s good, this is the plan. small ask — keep mobile notifications on for this thread during the window :pray:
